patch_description: Restructures the filter into explicit, reusable pipeline stages (volatility model → Kalman+RTS smoother → multi-scale SG bank → gated lead compensation → conditional quiet-region polish → end-aligned trim). Key change: the final polish is slope-magnitude-conditional — a narrow zero-phase SG pass is applied only where |slope| is below the statistical noise-floor gate (0.25*q_scale), blended via np.where. This attacks residual dither in flat regions (driving slope_changes/false_reversals down) without sacrificing responsiveness at genuine transitions, where the signal is left untouched. All stages are vectorized convolution or O(n) recursions; lengths are explicitly guarded to avoid trim mismatches.
